integrity: Finite exact symbolic transfer and graph-subset cross-checks are reproducible. Unrestricted circumference follows from a proof via local characterization and determinant, not extrapolation. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
limitations: Applies to labeled simple cycle prisms C_n Cartesian K_2 for n>=3 only, not orbits or general products. A related 2026 convex-partition proceeding was accessible at abstract level only; equivalent results in unindexed literature remain possible.
title: The cardinality-refined \(P_3\)-convex-set polynomial of circular ladders
